servers.description: Checks that a package, container image, repository or DOI an agent recalled actually exists before it installs, imports or cites it. Flags phantoms (names models invent) and squats (phantoms someone has since registered).

tools.name: hallux_check_command
tools.description: Check every dependency an install or run command would pull in, before running it.

tools.name: hallux_check
tools.description: Verify one or more recalled identifiers: exists, deprecated, absent, phantom, squat or unknown.

tools.name: hallux_check_manifest
tools.description: Check a dependency file after editing it and before installing or committing.

tools.name: hallux_watch
tools.description: Register identifiers for a signed webhook when their verdict changes.

tools.name: hallux_report
tools.description: Report identifiers a model produced that turned out not to exist.

tools.name: hallux_account
tools.description: Show credits, plan and pricing for the key in use, or free-tier status.

pricing.free: 500 identifiers per day without a key

servers.description: Reads untrusted web content for an agent: fetches a page or scans content already in hand and returns clean markdown with hidden instructions and prompt-injection payloads removed.

tools.name: cordon_read
tools.description: Fetch a URL and return clean markdown with hidden instructions removed; use instead of a raw fetch.

tools.name: cordon_scan
tools.description: Scan text or HTML already in hand for hidden instructions and injection payloads.

pricing.free: 50 units per day without a key; x402 pay-per-call supported
